findings.exact_correction: Contain bounded JSON decoder integer-conversion ValueError as one invalid candidate category and continue valid peers, without disabling Python limits or logging raw data. Add an under-65536-byte oversized-integer plus valid-peer regression. Keep canonical field validation and schema-first classification.
findings.observed_deficiency: A completed candidate containing {"schema_version":1,"future":<5000 decimal digits>} is only 5029 bytes, but json.loads raises ValueError from Python integer-string conversion protection. _read_candidate does not catch this decoder ValueError; read_metric_records aborts before returning candidate counts and valid peers. Independently reproduced on the prescribed skill-tools interpreter.

findings.resolution_summary: The guarded parse_int callback converts oversized integer values to opaque values without disabling conversion limits. Unknown extra fields are ignored by the canonical projection; oversized required integer fields fail exact-type validation in their proper category. Decoder ValueError is caught per candidate, and the under-limit huge-integer regression returns both valid projected identities without aborting peers.
